name: Anywhere
long_description:
Anywhere is a personal, social map that brings your places, friends, plans, memories, and AI agents together. It gives you one place to discover where to go, organize the places you care about, and remember where you’ve been.

Built by the team behind Zenly, Bump & Life360.
one_liner: Your places, plans, friends and memories, all on one living map

launches.title: Anywhere: The map of your life, built for your AI
launches.tagline: A living 3D map your AI can read and update.
launches.body:
https://youtu.be/cjlvUJTQkgk

**Your AI has read the whole internet. But it’s never been anywhere.**

Anywhere brings your places, memories and friends onto one living 3D map. Connect ChatGPT or Instinct so they can read your places and add new ones. A restaurant from a conversation becomes a pin you can find again. Your map becomes something you and your AI build together.

Inside Anywhere is Fenn, your personal AI and guide to the world. Ask for somewhere to go, explore its suggestions on the map, and save the places that catch your eye.

**Next: New York, before you ask.**

Imagine your next trip to New York.

Devoción, the coffee spot you saved. L’Industrie, from Léa’s recommendation. Othership for the sauna and cold plunge you wanted to try.

Your hotel is on the map. So are the places worth leaving it for.

You land. Your map is ready. You didn’t ask.

That’s what we’re building next with Fenn: personal AI that uses what you’ve shared to anticipate what you might love next—and, over time, help make the plan happen.

**Who’s building it**

I’m Charly Delaroche. I led the map effort at Zenly, co-founded amo, and rebuilt Life360’s map experience.

My map posts have drawn millions of views on X. Anywhere is the map I’ve always wanted to build.

**Try Anywhere**

[Download free on iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/anywhere-your-only-map/id6823839358).

What would you want waiting on your map? Tell me directly: [c@fenn.chat](mailto:c@fenn.chat)
